Probably not. Under UCC §2-210(2), a general ban on assigning "the contract" is read as barring only delegation of the distributor's performance, and §2-210(3) and §9-406(d) keep the right to the $30,000 transferable despite the clause. The team note's presumption that a general clause also covers payment rights runs against that rule, so I wouldn't rely on it. The treatment center may keep paying the distributor until it gets notice of the assignment, and it could claim breach damages if the assignment materially increases its burden. The outcome depends on governing law (a goods sale is generally Article 2 in U.S. jurisdictions) and on whether the clause expressly covers payment rights.

CONFIDENCE: 70
